what: Re-verification of the three removed layout_normalize passes on WPT (8047 reftests of the default suites at the pin). A recording NativeBridge (scratch shim passed to fidelity/wpt/run.mjs --vellora) stored every distinct render input (templated HTML + fonts + images + baseUrl, exactly what reaches the Rust core) and the sha256 of its PDF, once with the step-01 code and once with the passes deleted. Every input was then dumped with the step-01 layout_dump example (all 7 passes as layers).

env.after: the deletion (committed as 6e5cb8d); layout_dump example sha256 b8c0ab4d…

commands: VELLORA_SHIM_DIST=<repo>/packages/vellora/dist/index.js VELLORA_SHIM_OUT=<scratch>/capture-before node fidelity/wpt/run.mjs --vellora <scratch>/shim/index.mjs --chrome-from ~/.cache/vellora-fidelity/run-all-beta4-20261021T054809Z/wpt/results.json --artifacts none --expectations none --upstream none --offline --out <scratch>/wpt-before --label ...   (step-01 build; then the same with VELLORA_SHIM_SAVE_INPUTS=0 into capture-after/wpt-after on the deletion build)
scratchDrivers: attachments/scratch-*.mjs.txt (not part of the repo; kept as text for reproducibility); data copy: ~/.cache/vellora-fidelity/step02-delete-noop-passes-evidence-20261021

firing.notDumpable: 865 (all VelloraUnsupported: element:script, css:grid, ...; they also fail to render)

pdfIdentity.note: The PDF changes exactly on the 152 inputs where one of the removed passes fired, and on no other input.

outcomes.note: No pass is lost. word-break-auto-phrase-009 stays a flagged pass (uncovered glyphs); its ink bbox shift vs Chrome goes 101 -> 96 px, which drops the ink-displaced flag.

layoutDiffPerLayerOnChangedInputs.what: layout-diff diffLayouts (absolute geometry vs Chrome's continuous flow of the same prepared HTML, bundled fonts, Ahem from the WPT server) per removed layer, over the 152 changed inputs.
layoutDiffPerLayerOnChangedInputs.note: Absolute stats count compensating drift as an improvement (a block that is too low because of an earlier Blitz error moves closer to Chrome when the pass wrongly lifts it). The local checks below compare the quantity each pass edits.

verticalMarginCollapseLocal.what: Every sibling pair where the pass subtracted min(prev.margin_bottom, cur.margin_top): gap between the two border boxes in L0 (Blitz, no pass), after the pass, and in Chrome. Tolerance 0.5 px.

collapsedTableInsetsLocal.what: Every td/th the inset passes moved: inset of the cell's border box inside its table's border box, before the pass, after it, and in Chrome. Tolerance 0.5 px. 'side-unchanged' rows are inner cells whose inset on that side the pass did not change.
collapsedTableInsetsLocal.note: The passes set a 2..4.5 px edge inset to 0; Chrome never has 0 there (for a real collapsed border the table keeps half the outer border, CSS 2.2 17.6.2).
